description: This file defines the 'Theme' controller class within the OpenCart admin module, handling various themes management functions such as listing, editing, creating, and deleting themes. It includes methods for rendering views, processing form submissions, and managing theme files and templates.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for listing, editing, creating, deleting, and displaying theme templates and files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main theme management page, displaying the list of themes and related options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of themes with pagination, used for rendering the theme list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the data needed to display the theme list with pagination and associated information.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and returns a paginated list of themes, including store and status info.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Method used internally to prepare data for the theme list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the display and processing of the theme creation/edit form.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Displays individual theme template files, allowing editing and uploading templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving theme data, including adding new themes and editing existing ones.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected themes.
